bible.summary: Countryside: village, farm, forest, river — fishermen, hunters, farmers. Default view (village): log hut with carved window frames and chimney smoke on the left (house), picket fence with clay pots, a cat and sunflowers, a well behind the fence, hens and a rooster (fence), birches on the right (tree), a river and a church in the distance.

variants.change: dense forest: misty rows of pines with light rays, birches, a fallen log, ferns, a blueberry bush, stumps and mushrooms, big pines at the edges with a squirrel and a woodpecker, a path in the middle

river bank: far bank with a village and a church, water with reflections, lily pads, a duck with ducklings, a moored rowing boat and a wooden jetty on the right, a fishing rod with a float and a bucket, reeds on the left, sandy shore
farm: red barn with a hay loft and a rooster weathervane on the right, hay bales and a pitchfork, hens and a rooster, a rail fence, cows and sheep in the far field, a water tower

dacha garden: greenhouse with tomatoes on the left, an apple tree, a small dacha house, a scarecrow, a birdhouse, sunflowers behind the fence, a vegetable bed with cabbages and carrots, a spade, a wheelbarrow, a watering can
mountains: snowy ranges, a waterfall, an eagle, an alpine meadow with a hut, a signpost «ВЕРШИНА / ДОМ», pines, boulders, a trail, edelweiss
